arabic text: BAZAAR-E SHAAM SAJAYA, HAY SHAAM WAALON NE
english translation text: The marketplace of Shaam was decorated—alas—by the people of Shaam.

arabic text: AALE AHMAD KO SATAAYA HAI SHAAM WAALON NE
english translation text: The family of Ahmad was tormented by the people of Shaam.

arabic text: HUSAYN JIN KE RAHE NAAZ THE MANAATE RASOOL\nMADINA PAAK CHURAYA HAI SHAAM WAALON NE
english translation text: Husayn, whom the Messenger cherished with pride,\nwas driven from sacred Madina by the people of Shaam.

arabic text: HUSAYN KARBOBALA MEI THE DE RAHE SAJDA\nUN PE KHANJAR BHI CHALAAYA HAI SHAAM WAALON NE
english translation text: Husayn was in prostration at Karbala,\nyet the people of Shaam drew the dagger across him.

arabic text: RUHUL AMEEN HAI KARTE THE JIS KI DARBAANI\nWO PAAK GHAR BHI JALAAYA HAI SHAAM WAALON NE
english translation text: The pure house once guarded by Ruh al-Amin\nwas burned by the people of Shaam.

arabic text: JIN KI TAWQEER KI HAI AAYAT-E TATHEER GAWAA\nDARBADAR UNKO PHIRAYA HAI SHAAM WAALON NE
english translation text: The Verse of Purification testifies to their honour,\nyet the people of Shaam drove them from place to place.

arabic text: HOWSLA SAAR-E RASOOLON KI HAI ZAHRA SAANI\nUNKO DARBAAR DIKHAAYA HAI SHAAM WAALON NE
english translation text: Zahra’s second image carried the courage of all the Messengers,\nyet the people of Shaam forced her into the court.
